{"proof":"  have hS : S = ({(-14 : ℝ), 8} : Finset ℝ) := by
    ext x
    rw [h₀]
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have h : (x + 14) * (x - 8) = 0 := by nlinarith [hx]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
      · left; linarith
      · right; linarith
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
  rw [hS]
  norm_num"}
